description: This Kotlin source file defines the ApiClient class used for network communication in the app. It sets up Retrofit and OkHttp clients with mock interceptors, auth headers, token refresh logic, and logging for a demo environment.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A singleton class that manages Retrofit API creation with mock backend, auth headers, token refreshing, and logging for the app.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Constructs a fully configured ApiClient instance with mock backend interceptors, auth header, token refresher, and logging.

methods.name: loggingInterceptor
methods.description: Creates and configures a HttpLoggingInterceptor for request/response logging. Used internally in create().
